purpose: Define an employment contract/relationship as a long-running Project whose recurring periods and concrete work are represented by child/leaf Projects.

topics.name: Employment Project
topics.purpose: Define an employment contract/relationship as a long-running Project whose recurring periods and concrete work are represented by child/leaf Projects.

semantics.representation_rule: Employment contract is a Project because it establishes continuing recurring work.
semantics.parent_rule: The employment Project represents the continuing relationship/work scope.
semantics.recurrence_rule: Recurring periods such as week-by-week work may be child Projects.
semantics.task_rule: Concrete assignments remain Projects/leaf Projects, not a separate employment-task primitive.
semantics.evidence_rule: Merit/evidence links to the actual relevant Project periods/work units.
semantics.legal_boundary_rule: Project representation models canonical work structure; it does not by itself replace external legal requirements or terms.

invariants.rule: Project/task, execution, evidence and merit semantics are explicit and non-duplicated.

hard_gates.condition: separate employment-work primitive duplicates Project semantics
recurring work stored outside Project tree without explicit reason
all employment merits collapsed to relationship root without underlying work evidence
Project representation claimed to override external legal requirements

references.purpose: Employment reuses the universal Project primitive.
